description: This file defines the SuiteTCPDF class which extends the TCPDF library to provide custom header and footer functionality for PDF generation in the SuiteCRM project.

classes.name: SuiteCRM\PDF\TCPDF\SuiteTCPDF
classes.description: A subclass of TCPDF providing customizable HTML headers and footers for PDF documents within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: getHtmlHeader
methods.description: Returns the HTML content used for the PDF header.

methods.name: setHtmlHeader
methods.description: Sets the HTML content for the PDF header.

methods.name: getHtmlFooter
methods.description: Returns the HTML content used for the PDF footer.

methods.name: setHtmlFooter
methods.description: Sets the HTML content for the PDF footer, with placeholders replaced by dynamic content.

methods.name: Header
methods.description: Overrides the TCPDF Header method to include custom HTML header.

methods.name: Footer
methods.description: Overrides the TCPDF Footer method to include custom HTML footer.
